blurb: Bayou Games offers paintball experiences with rental equipment for beginners and recreational players, including three skill/age levels of paintball, GellyBall, Airsoft, and Laser Tag. They provide private party packages with playing time and party time in covered areas with picnic tables and event hosts. Mobile event services are available with safety and location restrictions.
